headline: Merz calls Magdeburg the CDU’s worst defeat in decades and refuses to quit; Berlin’s second ransomware dump gets a KI triage plan; BepiColombo’s transfer module is gone.

stories.title: Merz: Magdeburg is the CDU’s worst defeat in decades — and he won’t quit
facts: tagesschau (~14:56): after CDU Spitzengremien, Merz calls it “die schwerste Wahlniederlage … seit Jahrzehnten”; “zutiefst schockiert”; “Konsequenzen” without naming them.
Same briefing: “Aufgeben ist für mich keine Option”; reforms stay, but he’ll talk SPD on pension/tax volume and try to reach people “in ihrer ganzen Emotionalität.”
Institutions line: “wehrhaft und stabil”; Grundgesetz will be enforced — message also aimed at European partners.
Schulze: CDU “keinen Regierungsauftrag mehr … Opposition”; Regierungsauftrag “liegt jetzt bei der AfD”; will put a Land board proposal tonight.
Handelsblatt BPK: Siegmund’s “Hand ist ausgestreckt” to all Fraktionen/Abgeordnete; needs a “stabile Mehrheit” (not the absolute majority he once demanded); BSW path not ruled out.
stories.whyItMatters: Afternoon tracked Brandmauer math; evening is the federal shock — Merz owns the scale of the hit, refuses to resign, and Magdeburg’s majority hunt (BSW/abstention/CDU defectors) is still the only path to an AfD MP.

stories.title: Berlin ransomware: second dump (~550k files); KI to triage risk
facts: heise (Mon): CDO Florian Hauer — overnight Sat→Sun another ~550–560k files hit the darknet; total now ~1.3M.
Plan: KI tools to classify/risk-rank files so the hottest packages get human review first (manual review of >1M is impractical).
Ransom was ~30 BTC (~€2M); Berlin refused. Slotty: origin still unclear; Rhysida often phishing.
BSI weekend note conflict: TerminalFix + fake Captcha needed an employee to open Windows Terminal — not a pure drive-by.
stories.whyItMatters: Weekend’s dump becomes Monday’s ops problem: without automated triage, a Land-scale leak sits unassessed while politics is glued to Magdeburg.

stories.title: BepiColombo: Mercury Transfer Module separated — arrival sequence on
facts: ESA: MTM separated 3 Sep; GO at 12:00 CEST, sep ~14:00, Doppler hint 14:20, AOS confirmation 15:49 CEST from ~200M km.
After ~8 years / 9.9B km / nine flybys, MTM’s solar-electric job is done; inert module stays in a solar orbit.
Next: MPO chemical propulsion to Mercury orbit insertion 21 Nov; Mio deploy early Dec; MPO science orbit Mar 2027; dual-orbiter science from ~Apr 2027.
Afternoon only had a one-liner in Dev notes — this is ESA’s full arrival write-up.
stories.whyItMatters: Europe/JAXA’s Mercury stack just dropped its cruise stage; the hard choreography (two orbiters, six-month arrival) is now live ops out of Darmstadt.

facts.text: Right to Repair Europe / Register: ~1y into EU phone/tablet repair rules, only ~18% of 2,334 EPREL records link real spare-parts/repair info; blanks & self-A scores common.
Sony WH-1000XM4C (IFA): classic ANC cans back at €250 with user-swappable battery (EU battery rules → Feb 2027); also CH730N €120 / CH530 €60.
UNITED24 / RBC-Ukraine: EU JV starts BARS jet-drone production early Sep; first units to Ukraine ~10 Oct; newest config ~1,000 km / ≤60 kg warhead; jet engines are the bottleneck.
Atlantic via HN: Tiny ~$70 Xteink X3 e-reader write-up.
